lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Summarise in two sentences: hat blows to fence; careful climb; hat recovered; smile.

FEEDBACK
Keep order and drop tiny extras: The hat blew to the fence. After a careful climb it was recovered.

CHECK
A summary is not a full rewrite of every sentence.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Write two plot summaries (60–80 words each) for different stories or chapters. Check order, remove unnecessary detail and keep the problem and outcome.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.
lesson.learning_intention: A plot summary retells the important events in order without copying every detail or adding new inventions.
lesson.offline_alternative: Use paper and pencil to complete the original task, then retain a photograph or short parent observation as evidence.

teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
"A child waits in fog for a ferry light, calls out, then boards when the light appears." Key events only, in sequence.

TRY FIRST
Summarise in two sentences: hat blows to fence; careful climb; hat recovered; smile.

FEEDBACK
Keep order and drop tiny extras: The hat blew to the fence. After a careful climb it was recovered.
teach_steps.explain:
A plot summary retells the important events in order without copying every detail or adding new inventions.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner make decisions based on specific language evidence, rather than guess or copy someone else. Keep the meaning accurate and explain the choice.

HOW TO WORK
Read the original example and locate the words or actions that support the idea. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Check your response against the feedback: did you address the same skill and show your reasoning? If a detail is uncertain, identify what would have to be checked. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than making the answer longer.
teach_steps.notice: A summary is not a full rewrite of every sentence. Correct the meaning, not just the appearance.
